What Appen sells

  • Frontier Alignment: Human data and evaluation for post-training (additional training to improve an existing model).
  • Agentic AI: Creates example task runs and practice environments to train and test AI agents.
  • Multimodal and Speech AI: Prepares speech, image and video data for AI training. It also evaluates voice agents.
  • Physical AI: Labels sensor data and records robot demonstrations for AI systems that operate in the physical world.
  • Model Integrity: Checks models for unsupported answers and bias. It also provides regulatory audits and ongoing monitoring.
  • Research Services: Helps research teams prepare model context and synthetic data. It also builds custom tests and AI-based scoring systems.
